thread:
maria (AE): OrbitLink CISO just paused the POC. Main issues: VPC peering, KMS BYOK throughput, and a security questionnaire answer about HSM attestation. They want exec-level assurances.

josh (SE): Got it. Do we have exact ask from their infra team? cidr, throughput numbers?

maria (AE): They want 10Gb/s sustained egress to their VPC via peering, hsm-backed keys with attestation, and confirmation we can avoid logging PII. Quote from CISO: "We cannot proceed without KMS attestation + throughput SLA"

ida (Sales-Eng): Short-term workaround: we can set up a dedicated tenant in us-west-2 with reserved instances and bypass peering by using site-to-site VPN. Not ideal but quick.

josh (SE): VPN adds latency and cost. Alternative: enable redwood-dedicated with pinned GPU pool + connection over private link. That gives us predictable throughput. I'll draft the config.

josh (SE): ```yaml
deployment:
  type: dedicated
  region: us-west-2
  gpu_pool: reserved-RTX6000
  network: private-link
  kms: customer-managed
``` 

elena (InfoSec): We need to confirm HSM attestation level (FIPS 140-2/3) and provide SOC2+ISO artifacts. I have the artifact pack but need approval to share with OrbitLink. Legal review required.

kevin (VP Sales): @elena please share with me and @maria directly — we need the one-pager for OrbitLink execs. Maria: what timeline did they set?

maria (AE): They want an answer by EOD tomorrow for the exec briefing. CTO of OrbitLink wants an exec bridge on Wednesday. They said "no POC demo until security signoff".

ida (Sales-Eng): Pricing delta for dedicated option (monthly reserved + private link + KMS): roughly +$12k/month. I'll get precise numbers and a short justification doc.

maria (AE): Please include migration runbook and fallback (use hosted + masking) option for demos.

orbit-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orbitlink-poc-2026 (created by @ida)

josh (SE): For the KMS attestation, we can offer KMS+/HSM cert letter and an on-demand key rotation policy. Drafting text for legal now.

elena (InfoSec): Also require data flow diagram (minimal) showing no PII stored and KV cache encryption at rest. @maria can you get their sample queries?

maria (AE): I have sample payloads — uploading to the thread. (uploaded)

kevin (VP Sales): OK. Plan: (1) elena + legal share artifact by EOD, (2) josh/ida produce config + pricing by EOD, (3) exec bridge Wed AM. @josh you own technical response, @maria you own exec coordination.

josh (SE): I accept. Will post the technical appendix here within 3 hours.

maria (AE): Thanks all — marking this as high priority. Updating the CRM and adding to the board. :thumbsup:
